highlights: Large libraries no longer trigger desktop cache warnings or duplicate themselves into browser storage.
Embedded cover, case, playlist, and artist artwork now moves into durable managed artwork files.
Cloud indicators appear progressively as each track finishes uploading instead of waiting for the entire library.
Partial albums show clear sync progress, and Account settings now displays the live track count.
notes: Fixes oversized desktop caching, externalizes embedded artwork into durable managed files, and adds progressive cloud-track and album sync indicators with live upload progress.
